title: React render snapshot
prompt: What does calling a state setter do to the state value already in the current render?
choices: It requests another render; this render keeps its snapshot
It mutates the current state variable immediately
It updates the DOM before the event handler returns
answer: It requests another render; this render keeps its snapshot
explanation: Current React 19 documentation says rendering calls the component and that render keeps one state snapshot. Hooks must be called in the same order at the top level so React can match each stored state cell.
